text.p: Australian midfielder Craig Foster on Friday said he was poised to sign for English first division club Portsmouth.

He would join a recent exodus of international team mates to Portsmouth where Australia national coach Terry Venables is director of football. Australian goalkeeper Zeljko Kalac and fellow midfielder Robert Enes are already at Fratton Park.
"Hopefully, I can keep a first team spot at Portsmouth," said Foster, who plays for Sydney-based national league club Marconi.
He helped Australia win the Oceania zone qualifying group for next year's World Cup finals in France. They now face a final qualifier against an Asian opponent later this year.
